name: Argus basics
blurb: A sample deck. Add your own JSON decks to this folder.

cards.prompt: Which background jobs does Argus show?
cards.answer: systemd --user services and timers whose names start with an agent key and a dash, such as backup-nightly.

cards.prompt: What does freezing a task do?
cards.answer: It stops the task and pauses its timer without deleting anything; thawing restores exactly what was on.

points.idea: stops it and pauses the timer
nothing is deleted; thaw restores it

cards.prompt: How do other devices reach Argus safely?
cards.answer: Argus listens on 127.0.0.1 only, and tailscale serve publishes it over HTTPS to devices on your tailnet.
